title: ZERVIAH
summary: Raleigh names ZERVIAH in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Zeruia, also printed ZERVIAH, mother of the sonnes Dauid said were too hard for him. Ioab was one of that house, and in the beginning of Salomon the onely one left. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. III, sig. 294a
